newsitem.title: NORWAY: Aker RGI says wants to keep Scancem stake.
newsitem.headline: Aker RGI says wants to keep Scancem stake.

text.p: Norwegian industrial holding group Aker RGI ASA said on Tuesday it had received offers for its stake in Nordic cement company Scancem, but had no plans to sell out.
Aker RGI and Swedish Skanska AB each own 33.3 percent of Scancem.
"Several parties have contacted us wanting to discuss the sale of our shares, but I don't want to comment on when and who," said Aker spokesman Frode Geitvik to Reuters.
"We do not want to comment further because we do not want to sell our stake in Scancem," he said.
A source close to Aker RGI said the company had been offered "significantly higher" than 300 Swedish crowns per share in Scancem. Geitvik declined to confirm that level.
Scancem's A share stood four crowns up at 274 Swedish crowns on the Stockholm bourse at 1046 GMT.
